facts.value: Withholding tables in force: SCDOR WH-1603 (Rev. 10/30/25) 2026 tables, 0/3/6%; SCDOR Information Letter #26-20 gives the Act 110 2026 schedule 1.99% (0-29,999) / 5.21% minus 966 (30,000+) and says withholding is unchanged until DOR republishes the tables

facts.value: Withholding uses the DOR Circular EN 2026 percentage-method tables (2.26% to 4.60% rates); the statute (77-2715.03) sets 4.55% for rate three in tax year 2026

facts.value: DRS: 'Use either the withholding calculation rules or the withholding tables' (TPG-211); the two methods can give different amounts; configured: DRS per-period tables up to each table maximum, TPG-211 rules above (CT.2, configuration decision of 2026-11-02)
facts.note: Size of the difference is not stated in the TPG-211 copy; the 0.48 residual in CT annex example 10 is a derived comparison (rules 79.30 vs table 78.82), not a DRS statement.

facts.value: Ohio withholding follows the tax commissioner's tables under ORC 5747.06, graduated 1.6% / 2.99% / 3.4% from 2026-08-01 (US-OH-006, US-OHS5-001); the ORC 5747.02 statute rate for TY2026 and thereafter is a flat 2.75% over 26,050 (US-OHS5-007) - use the tables for withholding
Use 8,750 federal-tax subtraction cap (pp.6-7 formula); DOR publication also prints 8,500 and its example 1 is mis-computed
Act 24 SLH 2026 changes TY2027 brackets (new 13% top); 2027 withholding indeterminate until DOTAX issues 2027 Booklet A

facts.value: 4.99% for taxable years beginning on/after 2026-01-01 (5.19% before); from 2027-01-01 reduced by 0.125 point annually to 3.99%, each step delayed one year if an OPB trigger holds at 1 December
facts.note: HB 463 (US-GAS5-009): OPB reports by 1 December; the 2026-12-01 report date is not stated in the act text read.
